rules.claim: Risck Comply helps teams organise AI systems, risks, documents, tasks and evidence.
rules.qualifier: Operational support only; customer facts and professional review remain necessary.
Must not imply compliance, regulator approval or legal advice.
Do not publish while evidence is missing, stale or for another SHA.
Customer-specific legal compliance cannot be guaranteed by the product.
Name the exact certification/audit/test; never generalise beyond scope.

rules.claim: Replaces lawyers, legal opinion or automatic legal classification
rules.qualifier: The service supports workflows and evidence; qualified legal decisions remain human.

rules.claim: Automatic conformity assessment, CE marking or EU registration
rules.qualifier: Risck Comply is not a notified body or authority and cannot issue formal outcomes.
Do not claim automatic deletion from every processor or deletion of lawfully retained immutable records.
Public summaries are not signed contractual terms.
Avoid absolute security claims and describe the exact control and limitation.

approvalRule: Elevated or contractual claims require product owner, evidence owner and counsel approval bound to the reviewed version.
nonCreditingNotice: This register classifies proposed claims; it is not legal approval of any claim.
